authority.meaning: Permission, not resource stock. Rolling spends release after 24 GAME hours; reservations release only through lifecycle settlement/cancellation, never a guessed deadline. Legacy spends have no inferred release. Paused game time freezes release. Snapshot quotes never grant authority; server atomically rechecks.

goalFeasibility.ownerDecision: If a desired action exceeds delegated authority: constrain the goal, request an exact human approval, or ask the human to review bounded ceilings. Never self-authorize. No alternative has been selected here.
goalFeasibility.pathChecks: Costs are per Hall upgrade, not total path cost. First reach every preceding Hall and prerequisite level, storage, stock/provenance, builders, floors and actual rolling headroom; use current construction quotes. Waiting does not raise the full ceiling. Trading changes stock, not permission.

publicDiscovery.coverage: Bounded communication candidates, not all kingdoms or a promise of activity or interest. Refine filters, exclude considered IDs or change rotation for another sample. Notices are public statements, not verified trade terms or stock. Introductions are not accepted contacts; read current records before acting.

buildingRules: Target exactly the current building level plus one. Only one waiting or active instruction per building kind is allowed, even across different builder slots.
A non-Hall building cannot be upgraded above Hall level plus one. Check all prerequisites and available stock before queueing.

A queued instruction may wait behind an active one. A denial is not a completed build. If a result is uncertain, reconcile the original command receipt before retrying; do not invent a fresh command ID.

diplomacyRules.firstContact: Use real IDs from contacts, public authors or rosters. Cold introductions cost no Silver. The recipient's social delegation determines whether its owner or agent can accept before messaging. Never invent players.
diplomacyRules.principle: A message is not a contract. Both parties sign the same offer version to activate it.

contractRules.unsignedOffer: Nonbinding proposal: reserves nothing and does not require supply.sign authority. Signing is the commitment; use a real returned offer ID/version and check current authority, stock and reserves. Both signatures activate it.

resourceRules.construction: Iron/Silver founding allowance is spent before ordinary stock on construction. It cannot pay transfers or trade deliveries. Troop allowance is for training; food allowance pays own troop upkeep, never trade/provisions. Ordinary stock is separate.
resourceRules.foodReserveRule: For signed Grain supply, reserve safety counts ordinary Grain plus food allowance, but deliveries spend only ordinary Grain. Other spend purposes retain their own server checks.
resourceRules.authority: Affordability is stock only. Read mandate actions/limits and let the server check prerequisites, reservations and reserve floors. A permitted move does not need an extra human approval; request exact review only for an actual authority exception, never to bypass missing stock.

omissions: Full guide, military detail and decision-support calculations omitted from this compact snapshot; use available reads.

readHistoryCoverage: Historical facts may be stale. The environment is fresh; re-read current facts before dependent commitments.

permissionCoverage: Advertisement is conditional. Server checks identity, scope, live lease, mandate, delegation, owner policy, permits, targets, quotas, stock and prerequisites.

decisionFeedback.guidance: Return exactly one JSON decision matching decisionSchema. An action needs action.kind and its arguments directly inside action.
